title.ru: Налог на прибыль с распределённой прибыли

if_false.ka: ეს გაანგარიშება ეხება კომპანიებს (შპს, სს). ინდივიდუალური მეწარმე განაწილებულ მოგებაზე მოგების გადასახადს არ იხდის.
if_false.en: This calculation covers companies (LLC, JSC). Individual entrepreneurs don't pay profit tax on distributions.
if_false.ru: Этот расчёт относится к компаниям (ООО, АО). Индивидуальные предприниматели не платят налог на прибыль с распределения.
if_false.de: Diese Berechnung gilt für Gesellschaften (GmbH, AG). Einzelunternehmer zahlen keine Gewinnsteuer auf Ausschüttungen.
if_false.fr: Ce calcul concerne les sociétés (SARL, SA). Les entrepreneurs individuels ne paient pas d’impôt sur les bénéfices distribués.

citation.en: Tax Code of Georgia, Art. 97(1), 97(10) and 98(1)
citation.fr: Code des impôts de Géorgie, art. 97(1), 97(10) et 98(1)

legal_source.note: Distributed profit is an object of profit taxation (Art. 97(1)(a)); the taxable amount is the disbursement divided by 0.85 (Art. 97(10)); rate 15% (Art. 98(1)); all from the rad_law snapshot. Covers dividends only: other Art. 97 objects (non-business expenses, free supplies, excess representation costs), banks/credit unions (Art. 97(12), 98(4)) and international companies are not covered. effective_from 2017-01-01 is when the distributed-profit model started, not a verified date for this rule. Needs review by a qualified accountant before last_verified_date is set.
legal_source.search_query: amount subject to profit taxation calculated by dividing 0.85

if_false.ka: სხვა საწარმოსთვის გადახდილი დივიდენდი წყაროსთან არ იბეგრება (საგადასახადო კოდექსი, მუხლი 130(2)).
if_false.en: Dividends paid to another company are not taxed at source (Tax Code Art. 130(2)).
if_false.ru: Дивиденды, выплаченные другой компании, у источника не облагаются (Налоговый кодекс, ст. 130(2)).
if_false.de: Dividenden an ein anderes Unternehmen werden an der Quelle nicht besteuert (Steuergesetzbuch, Art. 130(2)).
if_false.fr: Les dividendes versés à une autre société ne sont pas imposés à la source (Code des impôts, art. 130(2)).

citation.fr: Code des impôts de Géorgie, art. 130(1)

legal_source.note: Art. 130(1): dividends paid by a resident enterprise to a natural person, a non-commercial legal entity or a non-resident enterprise are taxed at source at 5% of the amount payable; Art. 130(2): dividends received by enterprises are not taxed at source. From the rad_law snapshot. Recipient types other than individual/company, treaty rates for non-residents, and the agricultural cooperative exemption (Art. 130(4.1)) are not covered. Needs review by a qualified accountant before last_verified_date is set.
legal_source.search_query: dividends paid resident enterprise natural person taxed source 5%
